lines.ruling: Ruling: representation; project retained; model value dropped from the fixture. The filer made no traditional IRA contributions for 2025 (line 11a $0.00, on which the model agrees), and the worksheet is for figuring the deduction for such contributions (i1040gi p. 95, Line 20, "If you made contributions to a traditional IRA for 2025, you may be able to take an IRA deduction ... Use the IRA Deduction Worksheet to figure the amount, if any, of your IRA deduction"); the project shows the printed lines 7a and 7b as $0.00 for a return without traditional contributions (ira.any_trad) and the applicable amount, $7,000, otherwise (person.ira_line7). The model entered the applicable amount by the line 1 instruction (p. 97, "enter the applicable amount below on line 7a ... $7,000 if under age 50 at the end of 2025"). Line 12a, the smallest of lines 7a, 10 and 11a, is $0.00 either way, and the model agrees on it. No change to the data. [dropped]

Ruling: representation; project retained; model value dropped from the fixture. No one on this joint return made traditional IRA contributions for 2025 (lines 11a and 11b $0.00, on which the model agrees), so the worksheet figures no deduction (i1040gi p. 95, Line 20, "If you made contributions to a traditional IRA for 2025, you may be able to take an IRA deduction"). The project's printed line 1b answers Yes only on a return with traditional contributions (ira.any_trad); it is shown on the values sheet and nothing reads it, the deduction reading each person's coverage (person.ira_cov, Yes for the spouse here). The model answered from the spouse's coverage. Lines 6, 7 and 12 are $0.00 in both. No change to the data. [dropped]
